categories.main_business_segments: Youngone Corporation operates primarily in three segments: Manufacturing OEM, producing outdoor and sports apparel, footwear, backpacks, and functional fabrics; SCOTT segment, focused on premium bicycle and sports goods distribution; and Other segment, including outdoor brand product distribution such as Outdoor Research. The Manufacturing OEM segment accounts for 61% of sales, SCOTT 34%, and Other 5%.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs OEM manufacturing with vertical integration, producing functional knitwear including merino wool, synthetic knits, warp knits, and special functional fabrics. It invests in textile mills and advanced production facilities in Bangladesh and Vietnam, utilizing proprietary padding and fabric technologies, seamless bonding (CWS), and sustainable materials. The SCOTT segment focuses on premium bicycle technology and product innovation, including patented full suspension bike frames.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Youngone serves approximately 40 well-known global outdoor and sports brand buyers such as The North Face, Lululemon, and Patagonia, primarily targeting European and North American markets. The SCOTT segment targets premium bicycle and sports goods distributors and retailers mainly in Europe and North America. The Other segment serves North American outdoor apparel consumers through Outdoor Research.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with production facilities in Bangladesh, Vietnam, El Salvador, and Ethiopia. It has marketing offices in the USA (Seattle), Thailand (Bangkok), Vietnam (Hanoi), Uzbekistan (Tashkent), Taiwan (Taipei), and Japan (Tokyo). The SCOTT segment is headquartered in Switzerland with subsidiaries in the USA and Europe. Sales focus on Europe, North America, and Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Youngone operates primarily as a midstream manufacturer and OEM supplier in the global outdoor and sports apparel supply chain, producing finished goods for major brands. It also operates downstream in brand distribution through its SCOTT and Outdoor Research subsidiaries. The company integrates upstream textile production through its own mills to reduce lead times and improve productivity.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes R&D in high-functionality and high-value-added fabrics, operating a textile R&D center in Daegu, Korea. It focuses on developing differentiated products such as special padding, functional knitwear, and sustainable materials. Investments continue in automation and vertical integration to shorten lead times and improve productivity. Sustainability and eco-friendly production systems, including renewable energy and recycled materials, are strategic priorities.
categories.revenue_model: Youngone generates revenue mainly through OEM product sales of outdoor and sports apparel, footwear, backpacks, and functional fabrics to global brand buyers. The SCOTT segment earns revenue from wholesale distribution of premium bicycles and sports goods. The Other segment generates revenue from retail and wholesale sales of outdoor brand products. Sales are primarily export-based with credit and letter of credit payment terms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Youngone competes in the global outdoor apparel OEM manufacturing industry, which has high entry barriers due to functional product requirements and compliance standards. It holds a significant market share among well-known outdoor brands. In the premium bicycle market, SCOTT is positioned as a leading European premium brand competing with other high-end bicycle manufacturers. The company maintains competitiveness through product innovation, vertical integration, and diversified production bases.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, Youngone reported consolidated total assets of approximately KRW 5.3 trillion and revenues of KRW 3.6 trillion, with operating profit of KRW 637 billion. Revenue decreased by 7.8% in 2023 due to global economic uncertainties and reduced OEM orders, while operating profit declined by 22.6%. The company has shown steady growth over recent years with ongoing investments in production capacity and sustainability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Youngone differentiates itself by combining advanced product development capabilities with efficient, vertically integrated manufacturing to deliver high-functionality outdoor apparel and related products with shortened lead times. Its commitment to sustainability through eco-friendly production systems and recycled materials adds value. The SCOTT brand offers premium, innovative bicycles with strong design and technology leadership, catering to evolving consumer trends in outdoor and leisure sports.
